title: The Ghost of the Abandoned Temple
lines: In the city of Jinhua, a young scholar named Ning Caichen took lodging at an abandoned temple. The locals warned him that the temple was haunted. 'No one who sleeps there survives the night,' they said. Ning Caichen laughed. He believed only in books.

That night, a beautiful young woman entered his room. Her name was Nie Xiaoqian. She smiled, her voice like the tinkling of jade wind chimes. But Ning Caichen was a serious scholar. He refused her advances.

Nie Xiaoqian was moved by his integrity. 'I am not what I seem,' she whispered. 'A ghost under the control of a demon who feasts on the life force of men. I do not wish to harm you, but if I do not obey, I will suffer eternally.'

The demon came. It was a towering horror of writhing shadow and gnashing teeth. Nie Xiaoqian, defying her master, helped Ning Caichen escape. 'Go to Yan Chixia, the swordsman who lives on the mountain,' she said. 'His sword can slay any demon.'

Ning Caichen did not forget her sacrifice. He sought out Yan Chixia, a Daoist warrior who had renounced the world. Together, they returned to the temple and, after a fierce battle, destroyed the demon.

Nie Xiaoqian, freed at last, asked Ning Caichen to bring her ashes to a proper grave so she could reincarnate. He did more than that — he brought her home. And, as these stories often go, his love crossed the boundary of death.
